title: Score Validator
summary: Process an event list with score and wicket counter initially zero. Numeric tokens 0,1,2,3,4,6 add their value to score; WD and NB add one; W adds one only to the counter. Stop immediately when the counter reaches ten or input ends. Return [score,counter]; ignore remaining tokens after the tenth W.
officialConstraints: 1..1000 events, each from the listed nine token strings.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
